summary: Frontend-only validation of two bug fixes in Chez Dina Boutique: (1) rebuilt /login visual design and (2) varied product images in storefront. All verifications PASSED. Login left panel renders rich 2-column design (CD logo badge, dark→red gradient, 6-image collage, 'La boutique. Toute entière, dans votre main.' headline, 4 feature cards: Caisse rapide/Dispatch livreurs/WhatsApp intégré/Assistant IA, 'Voir le site vitrine' link). Right panel = white rounded card on soft pink. Password login (prefilled aouattaraesca@gmail.com / Admin123!) → /console with 'Bienvenue Aïcha Ouattara' + KPIs + charts. PIN login (1234) → /console OK. 'Visiter la boutique en ligne' link → /boutique OK. Catalog /boutique/catalog renders 120 products with 47 unique image URLs (confirmed via DOM scrape AND /api/public/products). Visible Robes products (Palm 93 white dress, Akwaba 58 red dress, Lagune 41 gold dress) use clearly different images. Product detail /boutique/product/:id renders image, name, price (32 500 FCFA), size variants (XXL/S/XL/M/XS), color variants (Rouge/Marron), 'Ajouter' and 'WhatsApp' buttons. /suivi/{code} loads without errors (shows 'Commande introuvable.' for non-existent code, as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Image variation is good (47 unique / 120 products = ~39% uniqueness, with 5-8 URLs per category pool). Acceptable for mock data; could be increased further if desired.
Login page design is polished and matches spec exactly; no issues.
test_credentials: Admin aouattaraesca@gmail.com / Admin123! (prefilled on form); PIN 1234 — both validated working
seed_data_creation: None — relied on pre-seeded 120 products from previous /api/seed?force=true run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs are fully fixed and verified end-to-end on preview URL. Login UX redesign shipped; product image variation confirmed via UI (catalog cards show visibly different photos within the same 'Robes' category) and API (47 unique image URLs across 120 products). No further action required for this iteration.
